headline: This Dividend King Still Has Plenty of Room to Grow
summary: Procter and Gamble just delivered five straight earnings beats while its stock quietly lagged the market, and now a specific corner of its portfolio is flashing signals that bulls say the setup for fiscal 2027 looks nothing like the headlines.
